releaseNotes:
• Chat [ Video ] bubble: clean preview-less video capsule with tap-to-play popup viewer
• Rewired custom status & presence pipeline with green/grey online dots, dynamic active presence, and profile status bar & friend count
• Rooms discovery: streamlined filter & tag bar (Filters | recently used tags) with search pipeline removed
• Beta Program: simplified to dual Premium and Premium Plus toggles
• Universal theme blur fix: pristine frosted surfaces across dark & light themes
• Active friends quick popup card with PFP, friend count, bio, and Follow/Invite to Room actions
